contents.text: What was the effect of the Ireland statutory tax rate difference on Microsoft's effective tax rate in fiscal year 2026?

The effect of the Ireland statutory tax rate difference on Microsoft's effective tax rate in fiscal year 2026 was a decrease of 2.6% of the federal statutory rate, which was $(4,301) million. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > Income Taxes)
